It is not recovered or reconstructed historical Phase03 authority. `PRODUCT_INTENT` remains owned by `docs/proposal.md`, and `PRODUCT_REQUIREMENT` remains owned by `docs/PRD.md`. This document defines externally verifiable technical guarantees, not implementation design. It does not select architecture, technology, modules, storage, algorithms, providers, deployment, tasks, or repository mechanics. Approval creates no `IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION`, `AGENT_REPOSITORY_GOVERNANCE`, or `EXECUTION_DECOMPOSITION` authority; no Stage07 result or implementation authorization; no Recovery Gate result; no Stage09 result; and no Stage10, release, or deployment authorization. It reads implementation evidence, requires `BUILD_LINT_TYPECHECK_EVIDENCE_IF_APPLICABLE` as a runtime input, and explicitly includes the `BUILD_LINT_TYPECHECK` check. docs\context\m4.3-build-evidence-viability-v1.md-39-Accordingly, complete available build/lint/typecheck evidence is potentially relevant to all three gate outcomes. Removing an evidence-file key could suppress a failure, blocker, or proof needed for verification. Removing fields from its compact JSON text could conceal verification facts. Authority does not establish equivalence between component absence, the producer's `{}` when the evidence root is absent, and a present summary with only `__context_diet__` when no applicable JSON evidence is collected. Explicit unreadable, skipped-size, truncation, and other omission markers communicate evidence limitations and are semantically meaningful to an evidence-sufficiency decision. docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-59-## 5. Deterministic invalidation

docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-61-Invalidation has two distinct outcomes:
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-62-
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md:63:1. **Full-baseline invalidation:** the baseline is not a permissible reconstruction base. It must be discarded for optimized reconstruction.
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md:64:2. **Direct-reuse invalidation with delta eligibility:** the baseline is not itself the current exact assembly, but a precise component difference may be represented as a delta if the baseline remains trusted, the common coordinate envelope remains valid, and all current fresh-assembly facts are unambiguous.
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-65-
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md:66:The following cause full-baseline invalidation:
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-67-
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-68-- stage coordinate change;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-69-- task coordinate change;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-70-- identity namespace or version mismatch, including an unrecognized value;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-71-- canonicalization mismatch or an unrecognized canonicalization ID;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-72-- duplicate component identity;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-73-- identity collision or any identity/content correspondence ambiguity;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md:74:- malformed or incomplete baseline metadata;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-75-- absence of canonical content or other required validation material;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md:76:- failure to establish that the baseline came from fresh exact assembly in the current controlled scope;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-77-- authority coverage below 100% or not determinable;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-78-- authority byte mismatch other than 0 or not determinable; or
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md:79:- a missing required authority-protected component in either the baseline or the proposed reconstruction.
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-80-
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md:81:Within an otherwise valid common envelope, the following invalidate direct unchanged reuse and require an exact delta rather than full-baseline invalidation when they are safely and unambiguously distinguishable against current fresh exact assembly:
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-82-
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-83-- changed canonical content at the same complete component identity: `changed`;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-84-- a component present only in current fresh exact assembly: `added`;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md:85:- a component present only in the baseline: `removed`, unless it is required authority-protected content, in which case reconstruction is ineligible and fails closed;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-86-- a changed complete component identity: one exact `removed` identity plus one exact `added` identity, never an inferred rename;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-87-- a complete component sequence change caused by exact additions, removals, or ordering changes; and
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-88-- an ordering change: `reordered` when order affects effective provider input.
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-89-
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md:90:A component sequence change is therefore never silently accepted. It is either fully and exactly explained by an eligible delta or it makes reconstruction invalid. Any unexplained sequence difference, missing identity, extra identity, ambiguous pairing, duplicate occurrence, substitute component, or ordering ambiguity causes full-baseline invalidation.

docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-95-
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md:96:A delta is the exact component changes required to reconstruct the current fresh exact assembly from a valid baseline. It is derived by deterministic comparison of the baseline with current fresh exact assembly using complete component identity, separately validated order, and exact canonical content.
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-97-
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-98-A delta is not a summary, semantic patch, lossy patch, inferred change, rename inference, transformation, or digest-only assertion. No wire format is defined.
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-99-
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md:100:Every baseline/current occurrence must receive an unambiguous category:
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-101-
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-102-- `unchanged`: the same complete identity has exactly equal canonical bytes and its required effective position is preserved;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-103-- `added`: a complete identity exists only in current fresh exact assembly;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md:104:- `removed`: a complete identity exists only in the valid baseline, subject to the authority-protection restriction in Section 5;
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-105-- `changed`: the same complete identity exists in both, but exact canonical bytes differ; and
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-106-- `reordered`: an otherwise corresponding occurrence changes required effective position where ordering changes effective provider input.
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-107-
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-108-Digest equality is only a necessary unchanged-content check. `unchanged` still requires exact canonical-byte equality, unambiguous one-to-one identity correspondence, and required ordered position. Categories may record ordering independently where needed to explain the exact resulting sequence; counts must be deterministic and must not conceal overlapping conditions.
docs\context\m4.2-baseline-delta-contract-v1.md-109-

+        temporary: Path | None = None
+        try:
+            descriptor, name = tempfile.mkstemp(

+            temporary = Path(name)

+                stream.write("\n")

+        backward: dict[str, list[TraceLink]] = {}
+        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
+        for link in links:
+            link.validate(current_version)
+            key = (link.source, link.target, link.affected_scope)
+            if key in seen:
+                raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"ambiguous duplicate link: {key}")
+            seen.add(key)
+            forward.setdefault(link.source, []).append(link)
+            backward.setdefault(link.target, []).append(link)
+        self._forward = {key: tuple(value) for key, value in forward.items()}
+        self._backward = {key: tuple(value) for key, value in backward.items()}

+        return cls(record.links, record.git.version)
+
+    def forward(self, identity: str, *, affected_scope: str | None = None) -> tuple[TraceLink, ...]:
+        links = self._forward.get(identity, ())
+        return tuple(link for link in links if affected_scope is None or link.affected_scope == affected_scope)
+
+    def backward(self, identity: str, *, affected_scope: str | None = None) -> tuple[TraceLink, ...]:
+        links = self._backward.get(identity, ())
+        return tuple(link for link in links if affected_scope is None or link.affected_scope == affected_scope)

+        failures=("failure-001",),

+        recovery_gate_provenance=("NOT_EVALUATED",),
+        git=GitIdentity(version, "change-001", "checkpoint-001"),
+        governing_decisions=("S07-PASS",),
+        links=tuple(links),
+    )
+
+
+def chain(version="v1"):
+    identities = ("G-01", "FR-11", "AC-11", "SPEC-001", "DES-008", "TASK-001")
+    kinds = ("G", "FR", "AC", "SPEC", "DES", "TASK")
+    return tuple(
+        TraceLink(source, source_kind, target, target_kind, "governed-state", "S07-PASS", version)
+        for source, source_kind, target, target_kind in zip(identities, kinds, identities[1:], kinds[1:])

+"""Repository-backed governed state and rebuildable traceability projections.
+
+The caller owns the location of the canonical record.  This module deliberately
+does not prescribe a repository layout or persist the derived link index.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import tempfile
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping
+
+
+ALLOWED_RESULTS = {"PASS", "FAIL", "NOT RUN"}
+ALLOWED_LINK_KINDS = {"G", "FR", "NFR", "EC", "AC", "SPEC", "DES", "TASK", "CODE", "TEST_EVIDENCE"}
+
+
+class InvalidGovernedRecord(ValueError):
+    """Canonical state is missing, contradictory, ambiguous, or stale."""
+
+
+class PublicationError(OSError):
+    """Atomic publication failed without advancing the visible record."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: Path, affected_scope: str, cause: BaseException):
+        super().__init__(f"failed write {path}: {cause}; affected scope: {affected_scope}")
+        self.path = path
+        self.affected_scope = affected_scope
+        self.cause = cause
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class GitIdentity:
+    version: str
+    change: str
+    checkpoint: str | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class AuthorityReference:
+    identity: str
+    artifact: str
+    owner: str
+    status: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class VerificationReference:
+    identity: str
+    result: str
+    evidence: str | None = None
+    gap: str | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TraceLink:
+    source: str
+    source_kind: str
+    target: str
+    target_kind: str
+    affected_scope: str
+    governing_decision: str
+    version: str
+
+    def validate(self, current_version: str) -> None:
+        if not all((self.source, self.target, self.affected_scope, self.governing_decision)):
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"broken link {self.source!r} -> {self.target!r}")
+        if self.source_kind not in ALLOWED_LINK_KINDS or self.target_kind not in ALLOWED_LINK_KINDS:
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"unknown link kind in {self.source} -> {self.target}")
+        if self.version != current_version:
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord(
+                f"stale link {self.source} -> {self.target}: {self.version} != {current_version}"
+            )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class GovernedRecord:
+    lifecycle_position: str
+    current_work: str | None
+    next_work: str | None
+    completed_work: tuple[str, ...]
+    authorities: tuple[AuthorityReference, ...]
+    human_decisions: tuple[str, ...]
+    affected_scope: tuple[str, ...]
+    task_execution_state: Mapping[str, str]
+    verification: tuple[VerificationReference, ...]
+    failures: tuple[str, ...]
+    invalidations: tuple[str, ...]
+    recovery_gate_provenance: tuple[str, ...]
+    git: GitIdentity
+    governing_decisions: tuple[str, ...]
+    links: tuple[TraceLink, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "task_execution_state", MappingProxyType(dict(self.task_execution_state)))
+        self.validate()
+
+    def validate(self) -> None:
+        if not self.lifecycle_position or not self.git.version or not self.git.change:
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord("lifecycle position and Git version/change are required")
+        if not self.affected_scope:
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord("affected scope is required")
+        authority_ids = [item.identity for item in self.authorities]
+        if len(authority_ids) != len(set(authority_ids)):
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord("ambiguous duplicate authority identity")
+        for item in self.verification:
+            if item.result not in ALLOWED_RESULTS:
+                raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"invalid verification result: {item.result}")
+            if item.result == "NOT RUN" and not item.gap:
+                raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"NOT RUN verification {item.identity} requires a gap")

+        for link in self.links:
+            link.validate(self.git.version)
+            identity = (link.source, link.target, link.affected_scope)
+            if identity in seen:
+                raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"ambiguous duplicate link: {identity}")
+            seen.add(identity)
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        return {
+            "lifecycle_position": self.lifecycle_position,
+            "current_work": self.current_work,
+            "next_work": self.next_work,
+            "completed_work": list(self.completed_work),
+            "authorities": [asdict(item) for item in self.authorities],
+            "human_decisions": list(self.human_decisions),
+            "affected_scope": list(self.affected_scope),
+            "task_execution_state": dict(self.task_execution_state),
+            "verification": [asdict(item) for item in self.verification],
+            "failures": list(self.failures),
+            "invalidations": list(self.invalidations),
+            "recovery_gate_provenance": list(self.recovery_gate_provenance),
+            "git": asdict(self.git),
+            "governing_decisions": list(self.governing_decisions),
+            "links": [asdict(item) for item in self.links],
+        }
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_dict(cls, value: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "GovernedRecord":
+        try:
+            return cls(
+                lifecycle_position=value["lifecycle_position"],
+                current_work=value.get("current_work"),
+                next_work=value.get("next_work"),
+                completed_work=tuple(value.get("completed_work", ())),
+                authorities=tuple(AuthorityReference(**item) for item in value.get("authorities", ())),
+                human_decisions=tuple(value.get("human_decisions", ())),
+                affected_scope=tuple(value["affected_scope"]),
+                task_execution_state=value.get("task_execution_state", {}),
+                verification=tuple(VerificationReference(**item) for item in value.get("verification", ())),
+                failures=tuple(value.get("failures", ())),
+                invalidations=tuple(value.get("invalidations", ())),
+                recovery_gate_provenance=tuple(value.get("recovery_gate_provenance", ())),
+                git=GitIdentity(**value["git"]),
+                governing_decisions=tuple(value.get("governing_decisions", ())),
+                links=tuple(TraceLink(**item) for item in value.get("links", ())),
+            )
+        except (KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"malformed governed record: {exc}") from exc
+
+
+class RepositoryStateStore:
+    """Publish one caller-located canonical record using same-directory replace."""
+
+    def __init__(self, record_path: str | Path):
+        self.record_path = Path(record_path)
+
+    def load(self) -> GovernedRecord:
+        try:
+            value = json.loads(self.record_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"cannot reconstruct {self.record_path}: {exc}") from exc
+        if not isinstance(value, dict):
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord("canonical record must be an object")
+        return GovernedRecord.from_dict(value)
+
+    def publish(self, record: GovernedRecord, *, affected_scope: str) -> None:
+        record.validate()
+        self.record_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        temporary: Path | None = None
+        try:
+            descriptor, name = tempfile.mkstemp(
+                prefix=f".{self.record_path.name}.", suffix=".tmp", dir=self.record_path.parent
+            )
+            temporary = Path(name)
+            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
+                json.dump(record.to_dict(), stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
+                stream.write("\n")
+                stream.flush()
+                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+            os.replace(temporary, self.record_path)
+            temporary = None
+        except Exception as exc:
+            raise PublicationError(self.record_path, affected_scope, exc) from exc
+        finally:
+            if temporary is not None:
+                try:
+                    temporary.unlink()
+                except FileNotFoundError:
+                    pass
+
+
+class TraceabilityIndex:
+    """Disposable forward/backward projection rebuilt only from canonical links."""
+
+    def __init__(self, links: Iterable[TraceLink], current_version: str):
+        forward: dict[str, list[TraceLink]] = {}

+        self._forward = {key: tuple(value) for key, value in forward.items()}
+        self._backward = {key: tuple(value) for key, value in backward.items()}
+
+    @classmethod
+    def rebuild(cls, record: GovernedRecord) -> "TraceabilityIndex":
+        return cls(record.links, record.git.version)
+
+    def forward(self, identity: str, *, affected_scope: str | None = None) -> tuple[TraceLink, ...]:
+        links = self._forward.get(identity, ())
+        return tuple(link for link in links if affected_scope is None or link.affected_scope == affected_scope)
+
+    def backward(self, identity: str, *, affected_scope: str | None = None) -> tuple[TraceLink, ...]:
+        links = self._backward.get(identity, ())
+        return tuple(link for link in links if affected_scope is None or link.affected_scope == affected_scope)
+
+    def require_path(self, identities: Iterable[str], *, affected_scope: str) -> str:
+        path = tuple(identities)

+"""Repository-backed governed state and rebuildable traceability projections.
+
+The caller owns the location of the canonical record.  This module deliberately
+does not prescribe a repository layout or persist the derived link index.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import tempfile
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping
+
+
+ALLOWED_RESULTS = {"PASS", "FAIL", "NOT RUN"}
+ALLOWED_LINK_KINDS = {"G", "FR", "NFR", "EC", "AC", "SPEC", "DES", "TASK", "CODE", "TEST_EVIDENCE"}
+
+
+class InvalidGovernedRecord(ValueError):
+    """Canonical state is missing, contradictory, ambiguous, or stale."""
+
+
+class PublicationError(OSError):
+    """Atomic publication failed without advancing the visible record."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: Path, affected_scope: str, cause: BaseException):
+        super().__init__(f"failed write {path}: {cause}; affected scope: {affected_scope}")
+        self.path = path
+        self.affected_scope = affected_scope
+        self.cause = cause
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class GitIdentity:
+    version: str
+    change: str
+    checkpoint: str | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class AuthorityReference:
+    identity: str
+    artifact: str
+    owner: str
+    status: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class VerificationReference:
+    identity: str
+    result: str
+    evidence: str | None = None
+    gap: str | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TraceLink:
+    source: str
+    source_kind: str
+    target: str
+    target_kind: str
+    affected_scope: str
+    governing_decision: str
+    version: str
+
+    def validate(self, current_version: str) -> None:
+        if not all((self.source, self.target, self.affected_scope, self.governing_decision)):
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"broken link {self.source!r} -> {self.target!r}")
+        if self.source_kind not in ALLOWED_LINK_KINDS or self.target_kind not in ALLOWED_LINK_KINDS:
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"unknown link kind in {self.source} -> {self.target}")
+        if self.version != current_version:
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord(
+                f"stale link {self.source} -> {self.target}: {self.version} != {current_version}"
+            )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class GovernedRecord:
+    lifecycle_position: str
+    current_work: str | None
+    next_work: str | None
+    completed_work: tuple[str, ...]
+    authorities: tuple[AuthorityReference, ...]
+    human_decisions: tuple[str, ...]
+    affected_scope: tuple[str, ...]
+    task_execution_state: Mapping[str, str]
+    verification: tuple[VerificationReference, ...]
+    failures: tuple[str, ...]
+    invalidations: tuple[str, ...]
+    recovery_gate_provenance: tuple[str, ...]
+    git: GitIdentity
+    governing_decisions: tuple[str, ...]
+    links: tuple[TraceLink, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "task_execution_state", MappingProxyType(dict(self.task_execution_state)))
+        self.validate()
+
+    def validate(self) -> None:
+        if not self.lifecycle_position or not self.git.version or not self.git.change:
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord("lifecycle position and Git version/change are required")
+        if not self.affected_scope:
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord("affected scope is required")
+        authority_ids = [item.identity for item in self.authorities]
+        if len(authority_ids) != len(set(authority_ids)):
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord("ambiguous duplicate authority identity")
+        for item in self.verification:
+            if item.result not in ALLOWED_RESULTS:
+                raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"invalid verification result: {item.result}")
+            if item.result == "NOT RUN" and not item.gap:
+                raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"NOT RUN verification {item.identity} requires a gap")
+        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
+        for link in self.links:
+            link.validate(self.git.version)
+            identity = (link.source, link.target, link.affected_scope)
+            if identity in seen:
+                raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"ambiguous duplicate link: {identity}")
+            seen.add(identity)
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        return {
+            "lifecycle_position": self.lifecycle_position,
+            "current_work": self.current_work,
+            "next_work": self.next_work,
+            "completed_work": list(self.completed_work),
+            "authorities": [asdict(item) for item in self.authorities],
+            "human_decisions": list(self.human_decisions),
+            "affected_scope": list(self.affected_scope),
+            "task_execution_state": dict(self.task_execution_state),
+            "verification": [asdict(item) for item in self.verification],
+            "failures": list(self.failures),
+            "invalidations": list(self.invalidations),
+            "recovery_gate_provenance": list(self.recovery_gate_provenance),
+            "git": asdict(self.git),
+            "governing_decisions": list(self.governing_decisions),
+            "links": [asdict(item) for item in self.links],
+        }
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_dict(cls, value: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "GovernedRecord":
+        try:
+            return cls(
+                lifecycle_position=value["lifecycle_position"],
+                current_work=value.get("current_work"),
+                next_work=value.get("next_work"),
+                completed_work=tuple(value.get("completed_work", ())),
+                authorities=tuple(AuthorityReference(**item) for item in value.get("authorities", ())),
+                human_decisions=tuple(value.get("human_decisions", ())),
+                affected_scope=tuple(value["affected_scope"]),
+                task_execution_state=value.get("task_execution_state", {}),
+                verification=tuple(VerificationReference(**item) for item in value.get("verification", ())),
+                failures=tuple(value.get("failures", ())),
+                invalidations=tuple(value.get("invalidations", ())),
+                recovery_gate_provenance=tuple(value.get("recovery_gate_provenance", ())),
+                git=GitIdentity(**value["git"]),
+                governing_decisions=tuple(value.get("governing_decisions", ())),
+                links=tuple(TraceLink(**item) for item in value.get("links", ())),
+            )
+        except (KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"malformed governed record: {exc}") from exc
+
+
+class RepositoryStateStore:
+    """Publish one caller-located canonical record using same-directory replace."""
+
+    def __init__(self, record_path: str | Path):
+        self.record_path = Path(record_path)
+
+    def load(self) -> GovernedRecord:
+        try:
+            value = json.loads(self.record_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"cannot reconstruct {self.record_path}: {exc}") from exc
+        if not isinstance(value, dict):
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord("canonical record must be an object")
+        return GovernedRecord.from_dict(value)
+
+    def publish(self, record: GovernedRecord, *, affected_scope: str) -> None:
+        record.validate()
+        self.record_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        temporary: Path | None = None
+        try:
+            descriptor, name = tempfile.mkstemp(
+                prefix=f".{self.record_path.name}.", suffix=".tmp", dir=self.record_path.parent
+            )
+            temporary = Path(name)
+            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
+                json.dump(record.to_dict(), stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
+                stream.write("\n")
+                stream.flush()
+                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+            os.replace(temporary, self.record_path)
+            temporary = None
+        except Exception as exc:
+            raise PublicationError(self.record_path, affected_scope, exc) from exc
+        finally:
+            if temporary is not None:
+                try:
+                    temporary.unlink()
+                except FileNotFoundError:
+                    pass
+
+
+class TraceabilityIndex:
+    """Disposable forward/backward projection rebuilt only from canonical links."""
+
+    def __init__(self, links: Iterable[TraceLink], current_version: str):
+        forward: dict[str, list[TraceLink]] = {}
+        backward: dict[str, list[TraceLink]] = {}
+        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
+        for link in links:
+            link.validate(current_version)
+            key = (link.source, link.target, link.affected_scope)
+            if key in seen:
+                raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"ambiguous duplicate link: {key}")
+            seen.add(key)
+            forward.setdefault(link.source, []).append(link)
+            backward.setdefault(link.target, []).append(link)
+        self._forward = {key: tuple(value) for key, value in forward.items()}
+        self._backward = {key: tuple(value) for key, value in backward.items()}
+
+    @classmethod
+    def rebuild(cls, record: GovernedRecord) -> "TraceabilityIndex":
+        return cls(record.links, record.git.version)
+
+    def forward(self, identity: str, *, affected_scope: str | None = None) -> tuple[TraceLink, ...]:
+        links = self._forward.get(identity, ())
+        return tuple(link for link in links if affected_scope is None or link.affected_scope == affected_scope)
+
+    def backward(self, identity: str, *, affected_scope: str | None = None) -> tuple[TraceLink, ...]:
+        links = self._backward.get(identity, ())
+        return tuple(link for link in links if affected_scope is None or link.affected_scope == affected_scope)
+
+    def require_path(self, identities: Iterable[str], *, affected_scope: str) -> str:
+        path = tuple(identities)
+        if len(path) < 2:
+            raise ValueError("a trace path needs at least two identities")
+        for source, target in zip(path, path[1:]):
+            matches = [link for link in self.forward(source, affected_scope=affected_scope) if link.target == target]
+            if len(matches) != 1:
+                return "INCOMPLETE"
+        return "PASS"

+import json
+from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+
+from sdd_orchestrator.governed_state import (
+    AuthorityReference,
+    GitIdentity,
+    GovernedRecord,
+    InvalidGovernedRecord,
+    PublicationError,
+    RepositoryStateStore,
+    TraceLink,
+    TraceabilityIndex,
+    VerificationReference,
+)
+
+
+def record(*, version="v1", links=()):
+    return GovernedRecord(
+        lifecycle_position="08",
+        current_work="TASK-001",
+        next_work="TASK-002",
+        completed_work=("TASK-000",),
+        authorities=(AuthorityReference("SPEC-001", "docs/spec.md", "03", "APPROVED"),),
+        human_decisions=("HD-001",),
+        affected_scope=("governed-state",),
+        task_execution_state={"TASK-001": "IN_PROGRESS"},
+        verification=(VerificationReference("TEST-001", "NOT RUN", gap="awaiting execution"),),
+        failures=("failure-001",),
+        invalidations=("invalidation-001",),
+        recovery_gate_provenance=("NOT_EVALUATED",),
+        git=GitIdentity(version, "change-001", "checkpoint-001"),
+        governing_decisions=("S07-PASS",),
+        links=tuple(links),
+    )
+
+
+def chain(version="v1"):
+    identities = ("G-01", "FR-11", "AC-11", "SPEC-001", "DES-008", "TASK-001")
+    kinds = ("G", "FR", "AC", "SPEC", "DES", "TASK")
+    return tuple(
+        TraceLink(source, source_kind, target, target_kind, "governed-state", "S07-PASS", version)
+        for source, source_kind, target, target_kind in zip(identities, kinds, identities[1:], kinds[1:])
+    )
+
+
+def test_repository_record_survives_session_loss_and_is_immutable(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / "owned" / "state.json"
+    RepositoryStateStore(path).publish(record(links=chain()), affected_scope="governed-state")
+
+    reconstructed = RepositoryStateStore(path).load()
+
+    assert reconstructed == record(links=chain())
+    assert reconstructed.git.checkpoint == "checkpoint-001"
+    assert reconstructed.human_decisions == ("HD-001",)
+    assert reconstructed.recovery_gate_provenance == ("NOT_EVALUATED",)
+    with pytest.raises((FrozenInstanceError, TypeError)):
+        reconstructed.task_execution_state["TASK-001"] = "DONE"
+
+
+def test_projection_rebuilds_forward_and_backward_without_becoming_canonical(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / "state.json"
+    store = RepositoryStateStore(path)
+    store.publish(record(links=chain()), affected_scope="governed-state")
+    index = TraceabilityIndex.rebuild(store.load())
+
+    assert index.forward("SPEC-001")[0].target == "DES-008"
+    assert index.backward("SPEC-001")[0].source == "AC-11"
+    assert index.require_path(
+        ("G-01", "FR-11", "AC-11", "SPEC-001", "DES-008", "TASK-001"),
+        affected_scope="governed-state",
+    ) == "PASS"
+    assert set(json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))) >= {"links", "git", "authorities"}
+    assert not list(tmp_path.glob("*index*"))
+
+
+def test_missing_path_is_explicitly_incomplete():
+    incomplete = chain()[:-1]
+    index = TraceabilityIndex.rebuild(record(links=incomplete))
+    assert index.require_path(
+        ("G-01", "FR-11", "AC-11", "SPEC-001", "DES-008", "TASK-001"),
+        affected_scope="governed-state",
+    ) == "INCOMPLETE"
+
+
+def test_stale_and_ambiguous_links_are_rejected():
+    stale = chain("old")
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidGovernedRecord, match="stale link"):
+        record(version="current", links=stale)
+    duplicated = chain() + (chain()[0],)
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidGovernedRecord, match="duplicate link"):
+        record(links=duplicated)
+
+
+def test_failed_atomic_replace_does_not_advance_visible_state(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / "state.json"
+    store = RepositoryStateStore(path)
+    original = record()
+    store.publish(original, affected_scope="governed-state")
+
+    with patch("sdd_orchestrator.governed_state.os.replace", side_effect=OSError("disk full")):
+        with pytest.raises(PublicationError, match="failed write") as failure:
+            store.publish(record(version="v2"), affected_scope="TASK-001")
+
+    assert failure.value.affected_scope == "TASK-001"
+    assert store.load() == original
+    assert not list(tmp_path.glob("*.tmp"))
+
+
+def test_truthful_verification_vocabulary_and_required_gap():
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidGovernedRecord, match="invalid verification result"):
+        GovernedRecord.from_dict({**record().to_dict(), "verification": [{"identity": "x", "result": "SKIPPED"}]})
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidGovernedRecord, match="requires a gap"):
+        GovernedRecord.from_dict({**record().to_dict(), "verification": [{"identity": "x", "result": "NOT RUN"}]})

+class GovernedRecord:

+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:

+    def validate(self) -> None:

+        if not self.affected_scope:

+        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()

+            identity = (link.source, link.target, link.affected_scope)
+            if identity in seen:

+            seen.add(identity)

+class RepositoryStateStore:
+    """Publish one caller-located canonical record using same-directory replace."""
+
+    def __init__(self, record_path: str | Path):
+        self.record_path = Path(record_path)
+
+    def load(self) -> GovernedRecord:
+        try:
+            value = json.loads(self.record_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"cannot reconstruct {self.record_path}: {exc}") from exc
+        if not isinstance(value, dict):
+            raise InvalidGovernedRecord("canonical record must be an object")
+        return GovernedRecord.from_dict(value)
+
+    def publish(self, record: GovernedRecord, *, affected_scope: str) -> None:
+        record.validate()
+        self.record_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        temporary: Path | None = None
+        try:
+            descriptor, name = tempfile.mkstemp(
+                prefix=f".{self.record_path.name}.", suffix=".tmp", dir=self.record_path.parent
+            )
+            temporary = Path(name)
+            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
+                json.dump(record.to_dict(), stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
+                stream.write("\n")
+                stream.flush()
+                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+            os.replace(temporary, self.record_path)
+            temporary = None
+        except Exception as exc:
+            raise PublicationError(self.record_path, affected_scope, exc) from exc
+        finally:
+            if temporary is not None:
+                try:
+                    temporary.unlink()
+                except FileNotFoundError:
+                    pass

+class TraceabilityIndex:
+    """Disposable forward/backward projection rebuilt only from canonical links."""
+
+    def __init__(self, links: Iterable[TraceLink], current_version: str):
+        forward: dict[str, list[TraceLink]] = {}
+        backward: dict[str, list[TraceLink]] = {}
+        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
+        for link in links:
+            link.validate(current_version)
+            key = (link.source, link.target, link.affected_scope)
+            if key in seen:
+                raise InvalidGovernedRecord(f"ambiguous duplicate link: {key}")
+            seen.add(key)
+            forward.setdefault(link.source, []).append(link)
+            backward.setdefault(link.target, []).append(link)
+        self._forward = {key: tuple(value) for key, value in forward.items()}
+        self._backward = {key: tuple(value) for key, value in backward.items()}
+
+    @classmethod
+    def rebuild(cls, record: GovernedRecord) -> "TraceabilityIndex":
+        return cls(record.links, record.git.version)
+
+    def forward(self, identity: str, *, affected_scope: str | None = None) -> tuple[TraceLink, ...]:
+        links = self._forward.get(identity, ())
+        return tuple(link for link in links if affected_scope is None or link.affected_scope == affected_scope)
+
+    def backward(self, identity: str, *, affected_scope: str | None = None) -> tuple[TraceLink, ...]:
+        links = self._backward.get(identity, ())
+        return tuple(link for link in links if affected_scope is None or link.affected_scope == affected_scope)
+
+    def require_path(self, identities: Iterable[str], *, affected_scope: str) -> str:
+        path = tuple(identities)
+        if len(path) < 2:
+            raise ValueError("a trace path needs at least two identities")
+        for source, target in zip(path, path[1:]):
+            matches = [link for link in self.forward(source, affected_scope=affected_scope) if link.target == target]
+            if len(matches) != 1:
+                return "INCOMPLETE"
+        return "PASS"
